blocks.tamil_translation: will your Ummah be afflicted with shirk?” When I asked Rasulullah ﷺ this, he said, “Yes. (But) they will not worship the sun, or the moon, or stone, or idol. Rather, they will do deeds to show off. And hidden desire is that one of you will be fasting in the morning, then when something he likes comes in front of him, he will break his fast,” (in this way he will fulfil his desires), the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذٍ ﵁ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: يَكُوْنُ فِيْ آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ اَقْوَامٌ اِخْوَانُ الْعَلَانِيَةِ اَعْدَاءُ السَّرِيْرَةِ، فَقِيْلَ: يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ! فَكَيْفَ يَكُوْنُ ذلِكَ؟ قَالَ: ذلِكَ بِرَغْبَةِ بَعْضِهِمْ اِلي بَعْضٍ وَرَهْبَةِ بَعْضِهِمْ اِلي بَعْضٍ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Rasulullah ﷺ said, “In the last times some people will be friends outwardly and enemies inwardly.” It was asked, “O Messenger of Allah, why will this happen?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “For his own self-interest one will outwardly befriend another. Because of the hidden enmity, the two of them will fear each other,” narrates Hazrat Mu'adh (RA).

blocks.text: Explanation:- People's enmity and friendship will be based on their own worldly gain. It will not be for gaining the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ مُوْسَي اْلاَشْعَرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ:خَطَبَنَا رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ، فَقَالَ: يَا اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْا هذَا الشِّرْكَ، فَاِنَّهُ اَخْفَي مِنْ دَبِيْبِ النَّمْلِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ مَنْ شَاءَ اللهُ اَنْ يَقُوْلَ: وَكَيْفَ نَتَّقِيْهِ، وَهُوَ اَخْفَي
